source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of simple harmonic motion (PDF 21).

blocks.text: Simple harmonic motion aik restoring force se paida hone wali oscillatory harkat ki qism hai. Kisi jism ke simple harmonic motion karne ke liye:

items: Restoring force darmiyani jagah se displacement ke barah-e-raast mutanasib ho.
Quwwat aur displacement Hooke ke qanoon F = -kx ki pairvi karein, jahan k spring constant hai jo spring ke maddah ki nau'iyat par munhasir hai.
Acceleration displacement ke mutanasib ho, a mutanasib -x; manfi nishan batata hai ke acceleration darmiyani jagah ki taraf hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Tamam dauri thartharahatein simple harmonic nahi, kyunke tamam restoring forces displacement ke mutanasib nahi hoti. Koi bhi restoring force oscillation paida kar sakti hai. Electrocardiogram dhadakte dil ka dauri naqsha banata hai, lekin is ki recorder needle ki harkat simple harmonic nahi, kyunke restoring force hamesha darmiyani jagah se displacement ke mutanasib nahi hoti.

blocks.prompt: Aik jism jhoolta hai lekin us ka acceleration displacement ke mutanasib nahi. Kya us ki harkat simple harmonic hai?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Yeh oscillatory (dauri) hai, lekin S.H.M. ke liye a = -(constant) x zaruri hai.

items: S.H.M.: restoring force displacement ke mutanasib, F = -kx.
a mutanasib -x: acceleration hamesha darmiyani jagah ki taraf.
Har S.H.M. dauri hai, lekin har dauri harkat S.H.M. nahi.
